reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) supports the role of nano-twinning in enhancing toughness and ductility in CrCoNi and CrMnFeCoNi alloys, but it does not address the specific (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 alloy, the proposed thermomechanical processing to induce twins, or the preservation of caloric effects.
